title: Student Dashboard Overview
content: The Student Dashboard is the main page for tracking internship progress, deadlines, announcements, notifications, company details, and quick actions. From the dashboard, students can open My Profile, Upload Resume / CV, My Progress Report, My Documents, and Own Company Request.

title: Upload Resume / CV
content: Students upload resumes from the Upload Resume / CV page. Allowed file types are .pdf, .doc, and .docx. Maximum file size is 10MB. The page also allows viewing or downloading the current uploaded resume if one already exists.

title: Resume Upload Result
content: When a student uploads a new resume successfully, the portal saves it as the latest resume and replaces the previous saved resume file. The page shows a success message after upload.

title: Progress Report Eligibility
content: Students can submit progress reports and the final report only when their internship application status is Approved. If the application is not Approved, the portal redirects the student back and shows that progress report submission is available only for Approved status.

title: Progress Report Submission Rules
content: Students submit reports from the My Progress Report page. Supported report keys are Progress Report 1 to Progress Report 6, plus the Final Report. Report uploads require a file and only allow .pdf, .doc, and .docx files up to 10MB.

title: Progress Report Status Labels
content: Report statuses shown in the portal include Submitted, Approved, Rejected, Submitted Late, Pending, and Missing. A report becomes Submitted Late when the student submits after the due date. If no report exists and the due date has passed, the display status is Missing.

title: Dashboard Deadlines
content: The dashboard shows upcoming or overdue report deadlines based on the student's cohort. Deadlines are shown only for reports that have not been submitted yet. Overdue deadlines are marked clearly so students know they should submit as soon as possible.

title: My Documents Page
content: The My Documents page provides sample or required document files for viewing or downloading. It includes items such as Indemnity Letter, Company Acceptance Letter, Parent Acknowledgement Form, Company Supervisor Evaluation Form, Progress Report Template, Final Report Template, and Student Support Letter.

title: Approved Status Documents
content: When the student's application status is Approved, additional documents may appear, including Appointment Confirmation Letter, Company Supervisor Evaluation Form, and Warning Letter. The documents page states these are required to pass to the company supervisor on the first day of internship.

title: Own Company Request
content: Students can submit an Own Company Request page if they want to request a company entry. The form requires student email, company name, company address, and confirmation that the student has no relationship conflict. The request is saved as pending for committee review.

title: Company Details on Dashboard
content: Students manage company details on the dashboard by selecting a company and address, then optionally filling monthly allowance, company supervisor name, and company supervisor email. The dashboard also accepts uploads for Company Acceptance Form, Parent Acknowledgement Form, Letter of Indemnity, and hired evidence.

title: Company File Upload Rules
content: Company-related file uploads on the dashboard must not exceed 10MB. If a file is empty, the portal rejects it. Successful updates save the uploaded file and keep the record attached to the student's application.

title: Assistant Scope
content: The AI assistant should answer questions only about using the Internship Training Programme portal, student submission steps, documents, progress reports, deadlines, internship status, company details, and supervisor or committee workflow. If information is missing or uncertain, the assistant should say so and suggest contacting the committee.
